name: Uppsala University
summary: Eight English bachelor's: six on Campus Gotland in Visby, four of them in game design, plus Egyptology and Holocaust and Genocide Studies in Uppsala.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry, and IB English meets English 6. Subjects count at grade 4 (3 at HL Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

dates.label: International round closes (for applicants who already hold their Diploma)

Final IB results due via the IB Result Service (recipient code UHR)
Reply to your offer or lose the place

notes: No Uppsala programme page shows an autumn 2027 intake yet (its pages still say autumn 2026), so the subject rules here are 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
Uppsala urges international applicants to use the January round; EU/EEA citizens can apply to some programmes in the Swedish round on antagning.se, with results close to term start.
Uppsala's Global English Studies bachelor's is not listed: its page says it requires knowledge of Swedish.
